concreteshow.title: Participation at Concrete Show South America
concreteshow.shortSummary: Technical and commercial attendance at the concrete industry trade show, accompanying management.
concreteshow.description: I accompanied my boss and upper management to the 2025 Concrete Show in São Paulo, leveraging my advanced fluency in Portuguese and my strong technical affinity for the construction sector. During the event, I provided strategic support in exploring innovations in concrete technology and heavy machinery, acting as a communication and networking facilitator with international suppliers and manufacturers for future imports to Peru.
concreteshow.note: This experience not only strengthened my knowledge of global infrastructure trends but also consolidated my bilingual negotiation skills and my ability to provide technical support to management in international corporate environments.
highlights: Direct linguistic and technical support to management during negotiations with Brazilian and international manufacturers.
Joint evaluation of new machinery, admixtures, and formwork systems applicable to the Peruvian market.
Facilitation of strategic networking for the establishment of commercial import partnerships.

china2025.title: Trade Mission in China
china2025.location: Lima - Germany - Abu Dhabi - China - Hong Kong
china2025.shortSummary: Intercontinental business tour acting as the official translator, cultural guide, and commercial liaison for audits and deal closures in Asia.
china2025.description: I led and facilitated a high-level commercial mission over the course of a month. Following an international connection route through Germany and the UAE, I arrived in China, where my role was crucial as a translator (Mandarin-Spanish), cultural guide, and business advisor. The itinerary included extensive factory visits in Shandong province for technical audits, followed by negotiations in the industrial hub of Guangzhou, and culminated in the financial center of Hong Kong with the formal closing of commercial agreements. My deep understanding of the Chinese market and culture ensured the expedition's overall success.
china2025.note: This experience consolidates my profile as a 'bridge' professional between Latin America and Asia, capable of breaking down language and cultural barriers to secure complex commercial transactions.
highlights: Real-time technical and commercial translation (Mandarin/Spanish) during manufacturing plant audits in Shandong.
Logistical management and cross-cultural guidance during a one-month expedition across key business cities (Shandong, Guangzhou, Hong Kong).
Strategic support in direct negotiations and the closing of international contracts in Hong Kong.

cantonFair.title: Canton Fair Participation
cantonFair.shortSummary: Participation in one of the largest trade fairs in the world, with exposure to suppliers, products, sourcing opportunities, and international business culture.
cantonFair.description: Participation in the Canton Fair provided direct exposure to international supplier ecosystems, product categories, sourcing strategies, and large-scale business dynamics. It was a valuable learning experience in global trade and market observation.
cantonFair.note: This experience reflects initiative, international exposure, and direct engagement with global trade environments, which is highly relevant for cross-border business and sourcing roles.
highlights: Exploration of suppliers, product categories, and sourcing opportunities.
Direct exposure to international trade dynamics and negotiation environments.
Practical understanding of large-scale global business exhibitions.

carMixerImport.title: Import and Commissioning of a Self-Loading Concrete Mixer
carMixerImport.shortSummary: Comprehensive management of the import from China, assembly, and on-site commissioning of a 3.5m³ self-loading concrete mixer in Ayacucho.
carMixerImport.description: I led the entire heavy machinery (Car Mixer) acquisition project. I conducted sourcing and direct negotiation with the manufacturing plant in Shandong 山东 (China), managing international logistics to the Port of Callao. Subsequently, I personally handled the unloading, mechanical assembly of the machinery, and its final transport to Ayacucho for immediate on-site operation.
highlights: Direct international negotiation with the factory in China (Shandong 山东), optimizing costs by avoiding intermediaries (traders).
Comprehensive logistics management: maritime import (Shandong 山东 - Callao) and coordination of national ground transportation.
Autonomous mechanical assembly and successful commissioning of the equipment (3.5m³ capacity) directly on-site.

formwork.title: Import and On-Site Deployment of Formwork Systems
formwork.shortSummary: Comprehensive management of procurement, international logistics, and on-site deployment of formwork systems from Shandong, China.
formwork.description: I led the international procurement of formwork systems for structural concrete works. I managed the sourcing and direct negotiation with manufacturers in Shandong province (China), coordinating the entire maritime logistics chain to the Port of Callao. Finally, I oversaw the customs clearance process and the direct transport to the construction site for immediate assembly and use, ensuring the continuity of the project schedule.
highlights: Direct negotiation with formwork factories in Shandong, ensuring quality standards and import cost optimization.
End-to-end coordination of the international supply chain: ocean freight (Shandong - Callao) and customs management.
Logistical reception and direct deployment of materials at the project site, accelerating structural workflows.

tyresImport.title: Tire Import and Supplier Auditing Expedition
tyresImport.shortSummary: Business expedition to Shandong province, China, for comprehensive factory technical audits and the management of tire imports to Peru.
tyresImport.description: I conducted a strategic business trip to Shandong province (China) to establish direct commercial partnerships for tire importation. During this expedition, I visited and audited multiple manufacturing plants, thoroughly assessing their production capabilities, quality control standards, and international certifications. This hands-on approach facilitated the optimization of the supply chain, successfully bypassed intermediaries, and secured highly reliable suppliers for the Peruvian market.
highlights: On-site technical inspection of multiple manufacturing facilities in Shandong to verify production workflows and quality assurance.
Direct commercial negotiation with international manufacturers, significantly improving cost structures and import margins.
Comprehensive comparative analysis of suppliers to ensure strict compliance with the technical regulations required at the Port of Callao.

vehicleImport.title: Import and Customs Clearance of Pre-Owned Vehicle Fleet
vehicleImport.shortSummary: Business expedition to South Korea for the negotiation, importation, and customs clearance of pre-owned Hyundai vehicles.
vehicleImport.description: I led an automotive import project by traveling directly to South Korea to audit and negotiate the acquisition of pre-owned Hyundai vehicles. I managed the entire foreign trade cycle, from physical inspection and purchasing at the source to coordinating international maritime freight. Furthermore, I strictly oversaw all customs procedures, documentary compliance, and the nationalization process to ensure the legal and successful entry of the units into the Peruvian market.
highlights: On-site commercial negotiation in South Korea, ensuring strict quality control over the mechanical and legal condition of each Hyundai unit.
End-to-end management of international logistics (ocean freight) and optimization of the automotive supply chain to the Port of Callao.
Expert handling of customs documentation and technical requirements for the swift nationalization and vehicle registration in Peru.
